title: Embed a state-aware voice agent in your web page
alias: a WebRTC voice AI agent embedded in a web page, aware of the page and able to drive it
summary: A voice and video agent in a floating widget on a documentation site. It answers from the docs through a hosted search tool, navigates the reader to the right page and scrolls them to the right section, and knows which page they are on.
scenario: Quincy for Harbor: a documentation site whose help is a person you talk to, and who moves the page for you
feature_line: State-aware voice AI, inside your web page.

evidence: agent: SignalWire AI Agent Automated Testing Protocol/agents/docs-bot/agent.py, 4b3967a, not yet in a repository of its own
